declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. 17 of the 28 pending cases include at least one qualifying section: attempt to murder (IPC 307, 3 cases), cheating/forgery sections (IPC 420/467/468/471/472, 14 cases involving alleged fake registration documents and vehicle-related forgery). The other 11 cases involve only public-order/disobedience sections (IPC 143/147/148/149/188/269/285/341/353/427/506, and two Prevention of Money Laundering Act attachment proceedings under Sections 5 & 17) that do not individually meet the threshold. No charges have been framed in any case and there are no convictions.
